label: Panchino gp28 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Panchino gp28 locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Panchino gp28 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual gp28 genes, Gp28 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, the Panchino prophage as a viral genome, recombinant Mycobacterium smegmatis strains expressing Panchino 28, unresolved restriction targets or methylation requirements, and other phage defense systems.
